snapshot.text: Insurance-based system financed through the NFZ, which an NFZ vice president says is not financially sustainable. Main challenges: waiting lists, doctor pay and staff shortages, plus a 2026 scandal over VIP hospital treatment that prompted urgent reforms.

priorities.title: Hospital pay and waiting-list reform
priorities.text: A government package proposes capping clinicians' hourly pay, limiting hospital wage bills, requiring half of working time in one hospital, and introducing an electronic waiting list.

priorities.title: Cardiology and neurology care expansion
priorities.text: Improving cardiac and neurological care is a 2026 priority, including a national cardiology network and more coordinated neurology and rehabilitation centres.

priorities.title: Drug Policy 2.0 reform
priorities.text: Warsaw is developing a project to simplify reimbursement procedures and speed patient access to new medicines, which currently face a record 1,211-day delay.

netherlands.text: A reciprocal healthcare agreement links the Netherlands and Poland on medical care and cost reimbursement for certain people living abroad. No wider bilateral health programme was confirmed.
